title: Containerise a Three-Tier Web App Step by Step
description: Packages a front end, API and database as containers with a compose file, health checks and persistent volumes, explaining each configuration choice and how to debug a container that will not start.

title: Continuous Integration Pipeline for a Student Repository
description: Sets up automatic tests, linting and build checks on every pull request, caches dependencies to speed runs and reports the time saved by each pipeline improvement. Includes a short guide on reading failed runs.

title: Kubernetes Deployment with Rolling Updates and Probes
description: Deploys a small service to a cluster with readiness and liveness probes, rolls out a new version without downtime and deliberately breaks it to show how rollbacks work. Includes a recorded walk-through of each failure.

title: Observability Stack with Metrics, Logs and Traces
description: Instruments a small multi-service app and links metrics, logs and traces to find the cause of an injected slowdown, documenting the steps an on-call engineer would follow.

title: Chaos Experiments for a Replicated Service
description: Injects failures such as killed instances and delayed networks into a replicated service, states hypotheses beforehand and records whether the system behaved as expected.

title: Cloud Cost Dashboard for a Student Team Account
description: Collects billing exports, attributes spend to services and tags, flags unusual daily spikes and sends a weekly summary so a team notices forgotten resources early. Includes a clear explanation of how each saving was estimated.

title: Blue-Green Deployment Demo with Database Migrations
description: Switches traffic between two identical environments and handles database schema changes with backward-compatible steps, proving with load tests that no requests fail during the cutover.

title: Self-Hosted Backup System with Restore Drills
description: Backs up a small server with encrypted, deduplicated snapshots to cheap storage, schedules restore tests and reports how long recovery really takes compared with the stated goal.
